notes.title: 1.18.0 (Small bug fix)
notes.notes:
Howdy Pioneers!
Hope you are having fun playing Wild West Saga!

What’s new:

Area 10 Fully Released!
Moved assets to asset bundles to help out with package size issues.
Added outro movie.
Outro movie can be viewed freely once game is done.
Removed Esigame package from Android version.
Added Appodeal to Android version.
Fixed issue with German language not working.
Upscaled textures in some versions.
Unlocking businesses only takes their Lvl 1 cost into account
Most menus can be navigated with the Enter and Escape keys now

If you got any feedback, questions, ideas on the new feature, feel free to reach out to us at contact@tamasenco.com! And make sure to follow us on Social Media (www.facebook.com/wild.west.saga and on Instagram @WildWestSaga).

notes.title: New Year, New Update! v. 1.9.2. [Hotfix coming to address bugs]
notes.notes:
[i]Howdy Partners! [/i]

[b]Happy New Year! Thank you for supporting us; cheers to a bright 2019 from everyone here at Tamasenco![/b]

New updates:
[list]
[*] An exciting feature arrives! You will now be able to see other players’ profiles when clicking on their username on the Leaderboards, including their online status!
[*] When clicking “Skip Tutorial” you will not be shown all features at once and instead will be slowly unlocking them as you play.
[*] Enhanced safety measures to prevent cheating.
[*] Fixed several undefined Businesses' upgrades names
[/list]

We hope you’re having fun playing Wild West Saga! 🤠

[h1]Update:[/h1]

We're aware of the bug troubling players (not loading Patent Cards and not correctly rewarding Daily Login) and we'll be dealing with the issue in the next few hours, so please bear with us.

To address your concerns: [b] your daily login streak will not be affected.[/b] You might only lose today's daily login reward (please pm me and we'll try to compensate you for that) but, come tomorrow, your daily login streak will continue normally. Thank you for your understanding!

[/list]

We hope you’re having fun playing Wild West Saga!

notes.title: Massive Update v1.7.4: New Features, Fixes, and a Voucher!
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy Partners![/b]

As we're heading towards the final stage of our Early Access state, we're proud to announce our new massive update! We'd also like to sieze the opportunity and recap what's been achieved so far. We woulnd't have reached so far without your input :)

[list]
[*]The Cross-Platform feature
[*]New Music in Areas 1 and 2
[*]A whole new Area 3 with new Businesses
[*]Revamped graphics
[*]New enhanced math models to optimize progression
[*]Reworked several in-game texts
[*]Implemented Steam Trading Cards
[*]Reworked the Achievements System
[*]Released several new Patent Cards
… and so much more![/list]

We won't stop here. Leaving Early Access will only be the beginning of our Wild West Saga ;)

[b]We're also celebrating our full release on Android by giving away this 500Gold Coins voucher: "WildWestCelebration"![/b]

We hope you’re having fun playing our game!

notes.title: v1.6.6 Update: New Maths, Family Costs, and Fixes!
notes.notes:
Nothing is ever boring in the riotous west! Enjoy our wild new features!

[list]
[*]New maths for Areas 1 and 2; it is now easier to progress and should help improve the overall experience of players
[*]Reduced the cost of removing a parent to 200 Gold from 500 Gold; it should now feel less punishing to leave a family
[*]Child Reset Gold Reward pop-up will now show up each time you Go West and reset; it was previously hidden under the reset cards making it unable to see how much Gold you’ve earned from your children’s resets.[/list]

We hope you’re having fun playing Wild West Saga!
[b]Feel free to contact us at contact@tamasenco.com![/b]
